stem: Priya looks at a drop of clear pond water with her unaided eyes and sees nothing moving in it. Her teacher says tiny living organisms may still be present in the drop. Which tool should Priya use to observe these tiny organisms?

options.text: A clean white sheet of paper

teacher.key_rationale: Microorganisms in a drop of pond water are too small to be seen with the unaided eye; a microscope (or magnifying glass for larger specimens) makes small objects appear larger so they can be observed. The other options provide no magnification, so B is the key.
